resources.string: SBTECH Investor Desk: Saudi Business Setup
Independent app by SBTECH. Not affiliated with the Ministry of Investment (MISA) or any government entity.

SBTECH Investor Desk helps you prepare your own business-setup notes. It does not sign you in to Nafath, MISA, or any other government service, and it does not submit or issue licences. Public references: https://misa.gov.sa and https://investsaudi.sa.
Sign in with your Google account. Your investor profile is stored in Firebase under that account.
Google sign-in is off in this build. Add app/google-services.json with a Web client ID to enable it.
Investor profile linked to this account
This deletes the Firebase sign-in and the investor profile stored for this account. Notes kept only on this device stay on the device.
This profile is saved to your Google account.
Sign in with Google from the account button to save this profile to your account.
